highlights.description: OCSF types, constants, and validation now come from `github.com/grokify/ocsf-schema-go`; the lake no longer carries a hand-written copy of the standard
Record-integrity support end to end: verify-on-ingest, attest-on-ingest with chaining, on-demand/full/incremental/sample/chain checks, and persisted check reports
New `ocsflake` CLI covering ingest, query, integrity checks, signing, verification, and test-data seeding

added.description: [validator] `OCSFValidator` backed by the compiled OCSF schema embedded in ocsf-schema-go, with strict, permissive, and disabled modes and no schema files needed at runtime
[ocsf] `StoredEvent.Decode()` returns the concrete generated event struct for a stored payload via the class-UID registry
[integrity] Record-integrity checker with on-demand, full, incremental, sample, and chain modes and an unsigned-events policy
[storage] `integrity_status` and `integrity_checked_at` event columns, a persisted `IntegrityCheck` entity, and `IngestedFrom` / `IntegrityStatus` query filters
[lake] Typed ingest (`IngestTyped`), verify-on-ingest (monitor/enforce), attest-on-ingest with optional chaining, raw-data retention, and an unknown-attribute policy
[seed] Deterministic schema-valid test-data generator with signed, tampered, and chained event mixes
[cmd/ocsflake] CLI with `ingest`, `get`, `query`, `count`, `check` (event, all, incremental, sample, chain, reports), `sign`, `verify`, and `seed` commands

changed.description: [ocsf] Hand-written `Event`, `ParseEvent`, and classification/metadata constants removed in favour of `ocsf-schema-go/ocsf/events` and `ocsf/objects`

[validator] JSON Schema validator, `validator.Options`/`DefaultOptions`, and the `ErrMissing*` sentinel errors removed; strict mode now enforces full schema semantics and permissive mode rejects only structurally unusable events
[lake] `Close` is idempotent and concurrency-safe, and batch ingest errors report the failing event position

documentation.description: Updated README, MkDocs site, and API reference for the ocsf-schema-go integration; added CLI, integrity, and seed guides, specs, and release notes

highlights.description: Initial release: OCSF event data lake with Ent-backed storage (SQLite and PostgreSQL), a Lake facade, and JSON Schema validation

added.description: [lake] Lake facade for OCSF event management
